The '''Pho Ph'eah system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Kalamith sector/Legends|Kalamith sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Pho Ph'eah/Legends|Pho Ph'eah]], homeworld of the [[Pho Ph'eahian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
